featured_reviews.name: Mahavir Rathod
featured_reviews.review_text: I had been dealing with persistent shoulder pain for months, and physiotherapy truly made a huge difference. Dr. Prachi was extremely kind, knowledgeable, and attentive. She quickly understood the root cause of my pain and designed a personalized treatment plan just for me. After only a few sessions, my pain reduced remarkably, and my shoulder movement improved a lot. featured_reviews.name: PJ BP
featured_reviews.review_text:
Absolutely unacceptable experience.

I was passed between multiple physiotherapists who gave completely inconsistent advice, sometimes directly contradicting each other. There was no continuity of care, no coherent plan, and no sense that anyone actually knew or cared what the other had told me.

They push you into buying a 12 session package upfront, creating the impression that you will be properly guided through recovery. That turned out to be completely misleading. On my final session, instead of giving me a clear plan for what to do next, I was told I would have to pay another ₹3000 just to be told how to continue. That is not care. That is a deliberate upsell at the last possible moment.

The quality of the sessions themselves was underwhelming. The physiotherapist I saw most often did not address my main issue, which I had clearly raised in the very first ₹3000 session, until I brought it up again myself. Basic attention to the patient’s stated problem was missing.

They also push expensive aqua sessions regardless of whether they are necessary. Everything feels structured around extracting as much money as possible rather than providing appropriate treatment.

What happened at the end was even worse. I was told I had already been given exercise videos. I had not. This was either carelessness or confusion with another patient, and there was no effort to fix it.

When I asked for my own treatment notes and progress details, I was refused on the basis that they were “confidential.” That makes no sense. I am the patient. Refusing to provide my own records is completely unacceptable.

Instead, I was promised a report. Of course, that was never sent either.

This entire experience felt disorganized, inconsistent, and driven by money rather than patient care. I would strongly recommend going elsewhere.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
We uphold the highest standards of clinical ethics, transparency, and patient care, and must clarify that this review does not accurately reflect your treatment journey with us.

A detailed assessment with a senior physiotherapist was advised to ensure continuity and clinical precision, which was declined. A structured home exercise program—with clear instructions and recorded guidance—was provided, however, the recommended treatment plan and sessions were not continued.

At your request, sessions were oriented towards fitness and transition to gym-based activity, including aqua and land training. All appointments were accommodated with courtesy and flexibility.

For clarity, no senior consultation fee of ₹3000 was charged. Requests for internal clinical documentation in photo/video format were declined in line with standard confidentiality protocols; however, a comprehensive treatment file was duly provided.

Our team remained professional and respectful at all times. We stand by the integrity of our processes and the quality of care delivered.

We wish you the best in your continued health journey.

The banquets halls serves well to host any functions. Lot of parking space open as well as closed. Adequately staffed and good security around.

featured_reviews.name: Shlok Agarwal
featured_reviews.review_text:
I’ve been a life member of GSC for many years and overall it’s been a great place to be. The food quality is consistently good, and the gym is well-equipped with everything needed for a solid workout. The trainers and facilities are generally well maintained.

The club also offers excellent wellness amenities including steam, sauna, and other recreational facilities, which add a lot of value to the membership.

The only downside is that the gym can get quite crowded during peak hours. More importantly, health and hygiene standards in certain areas need to be taken more seriously. While the steam and sauna facilities are good, they sometimes have a lingering smell of oils and can feel a bit stuffy, especially when heavily used. More frequent cleaning, better ventilation, and closer attention to hygiene would significantly improve the overall experience.

That said, GSC continues to offer a strong overall experience, and as a life member, I feel it remains one of the better clubs in the city for fitness, dining, and family recreation.

featured_reviews.name: Amberdeep Singh
featured_reviews.review_text: One of the Best sports club in this part of city which actually dedicates good amount of resources for sports and culturalactivities. GSC is loaded with lots of sports and general amenities. They have massive sport ground for cricket and other social events, Olympic size 10 lane swimming pool, separate pools for kids and even totally separate diving pool too. There are couple of basketball courts, multiple lawn tennis, squash and badminton courts. They even have 4 lane pistol shooting range and facilities for gymnastics, calisthenics, crossfit training, boxing and of course a big gym. There is a 500 meter walking track lined with trees and flowers making your walking experience pleasant. You can enjoy variety of food at their different restaurants and food courts. They even have a Library here with good collection of books with accessibility for non-members too. The staff here is very helpful and always there to offer their assistance. The washrooms are never far off as they are located all around the club and always clean and tidy. The club can accommodate good number of car in it's parking.

featured_reviews.name: VISHAL S (V1ȘĦ)
featured_reviews.review_text:
The pickleball facility at Matoshree Arts & Sports Trust falls significantly short of the standards associated with the Matoshree name. While other amenities within the trust such as the badminton courts, gym, and swimming pool are generally well maintained and professionally managed, the pickleball courts reflect a concerning lack of upkeep and oversight.

The courts are poorly maintained. Basic cleaning appears neglected, with visible dust and debris affecting playability. There is no attendant present to address concerns related to cleanliness or court readiness, which further reflects operational indifference. For a facility operating under an established sports trust, this absence of on ground supervision is disappointing.

The court surface itself is substandard. There are visible damages, craters, and uneven patches across multiple areas. These surface irregularities directly impact gameplay, causing inconsistent and uneven ball bounce. This not only compromises the quality of play but also increases the risk of injury. A sport like pickleball demands a smooth, uniform surface for predictable ball response; the current condition does not meet even basic expectations.

Lighting conditions during morning hours are another issue. Direct sunlight enters the playing area in a way that significantly hampers visibility. Proper shading or structural adjustments appear to be lacking, making early sessions unnecessarily difficult.

The acoustics within the dome shaped structure are also problematic. The roof design amplifies sound excessively, creating an echo heavy environment that becomes distracting during play. Instead of absorbing noise, the structure magnifies it, reducing overall playing comfort.

Overall upkeep of the pickleball section is poor. Given the otherwise strong reputation of Matoshree Arts & Sports Trust for maintaining quality facilities, the condition of the pickleball courts is inconsistent with the standards set by the rest of the complex. Immediate attention from management is required to restore surface quality, ensure routine maintenance, deploy proper supervision, and address structural issues related to light and acoustics. Without corrective action, the facility risks undermining the trust’s broader reputation for sporting excellence.

featured_reviews.name: vikrant chaudhary
featured_reviews.review_text:
I’ve been training at this gym for a while now, and honestly, it’s one of the best decisions I’ve made for my fitness journey. The facility is always clean, well-maintained, and equipped with a wide range of modern machines and free weights, so you never feel limited in your workout.
Another big plus is the crowd management. Even during peak hours, the space is organized well enough to keep your workout smooth. The music, lighting, and overall vibe just make you want to keep going.
Overall, Grace Gym is a perfect place if you’re serious about your fitness goals or even if you’re just starting out. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a great workout environment with professional guidance!
Vikrant Chaudhary ( Director )

featured_reviews.name: Aditi Mahajan
featured_reviews.review_text:
I have been a regular member of Grace Gym for the past one year and had also taken personal training (PT) membership. The gym fees and PT charges are reasonable, which is why many people join this gym.

However, the overall condition and management of the gym are extremely disappointing. The management and owner pay no attention to basic maintenance. One of the most basic amenities—air conditioning—is not available. In fact, the staff has been instructed not to use the AC. When questioned, the manager simply states that the gym was never promised as an air-conditioned facility.

The equipment is also poorly maintained. The treadmills are outdated and often stop abruptly while in use, which can be unsafe. There is no proper music system, and members have to repeatedly remind the trainers to switch it on.

Another major issue is the lack of adequate trainers. There is only one dedicated trainer in the morning and evening, who simultaneously handles multiple personal training clients. There is no general trainer available on the gym floor. PT sessions are conducted with multiple clients at the same time, defeating the purpose of personal training.

The management seems efficient only when it comes to collecting money, but completely indifferent when members raise genuine concerns. Despite multiple complaints, no corrective action is taken. Ironically, when payments are due, the manager named Yash is extremely persistent, calling and messaging repeatedly, which feels harassing.

Overall, I would not recommend this gym unless the management takes serious steps to renovate the facility, maintain equipment properly, ensure basic amenities, and hire sufficient trainers.
